disorder-name.detail: Bipolar disorder; diagnosed by DSM-IV (SCID-I) criteria, except Vancouver site (site id=7) which used Mini International Neuropsychiatry Interview. Clinical cohort applied to normative AE model trained on HCP-YA healthy controls.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "applied to multi-site external data of HC and BD individuals" / "subjects with BD (median age = 30.00 years, 101 females, 86 males)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Multi-site external test set from the StratiBip network (7 sites), an initiative originating from the ENPACT network. Post-hoc integration of multi-site clinical and neuroimaging data.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The external test set consisted of data collected as part of the StratiBip network" / "187 with BD ... across 7 sites"

age.detail: Age range (22–37 years) stated in main text; mean (29.625) and SD (4.371) from Supplementary Table 1 (BD-StratiBip row). Mean and SD rounded to 2 decimal places.
age.supporting_text: "only young adults were included, from 22 to 37 years old" / "BD-StratiBip | 187 | 29.625 ±4.371"

sex.detail: Counts from Supplementary Table 1 (M=86, F=101, total N=187). Percentages calculated: 86/187=46.0%, 101/187=54.0%.
